title: Attorney General James Announces Creation of AI Safety, Standards, Enforcement, and Transparency Unit
content_md: NEW YORK – New York Attorney General Letitia James today announced the creation of a new unit within the Office of the Attorney General (OAG) to protect New Yorkers from the potential harms of emerging technology and oversee laws regulating artificial intelligence (AI).
